We have re-implemented FFmpeg's `libswscale` image scaling and pixel-format conversion in Zig inside `/app/swscale-impl/`, building into `/app/swscale-impl/zig-out/lib/libswscale_candidate.so` and exporting the three C-ABI functions (`swscale_create`, `swscale_process`, `swscale_destroy`).

### Summary of Implementation & Optimizations
- **Entry & Context Management** ([`main.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/main.zig), [`scale.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/scale.zig)):
  - Implemented `SwsContext` managing horizontal and vertical filter banks (`hLumFilter`, `hChrFilter`, `vLumFilter`, `vChrFilter`), chroma subsampling geometry (`chrSrcHSubSample`, `chrSrcVSubSample`, `chrDstHSubSample`, `chrDstVSubSample`), full-range `GRAY8` vs standard-range YUV handling (`lumRangeToJpeg`/`lumRangeFromJpeg`), and ring buffers for horizontal-scaled luma, chroma, and alpha lines.
- **Filter Bank Generation & Tables** ([`filter.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/filter.zig), [`tables.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/tables.zig), [`yuv2rgb.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/yuv2rgb.zig)):
  - Re-implemented FFmpeg's `initFilter` fixed-point polyphase filter generation for `SWS_FAST_BILINEAR`/`SWS_BILINEAR`, `SWS_BICUBIC`, and `SWS_POINT` (nearest neighbor), including cutoff trimming, boundary clamping, and error-diffusion coefficient normalization.
  - Re-implemented BT.601 RGB-to-YUV and YUV-to-RGB coefficient and lookup tables (`Yuv2RgbTables.init`).
- **Portable SIMD Vectorization** ([`unscaled.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig), [`input.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/input.zig), [`output.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h_zjikdr/swscale-impl/src/output.zig)):
  - Implemented `@Vector`-accelerated unscaled converters (`unscaledYuvToRgb`, `unscaledRgbToRgb`, `unscaledBgr24ToYuv420p`) using planar/packed vector shuffles (`loadRgb24Vec16`, `storeRgb24Vec16`, `loadRgbaVec16`, `storeRgbaVec16`).
  - Vectorized input plane extractors (`rgb24ToY`, `bgr24ToY`, `rgbaToY`, `bgraToY`, `rgb24ToUV`, `rgb24ToUVHalf`, `nv12ToUV`, `nv21ToUV`), plus direct 15-bit `rgb24ToY_15` and `rgb24ToUVHalf_15` fast paths when horizontal scaling is a 1-tap identity filter.
  - Vectorized horizontal scaling (`hScale8To15`, `hScale16To15`) with specialized 1-tap, 2-tap, and 4-tap SIMD kernels.
  - Vectorized vertical scaling and output packing (`yuv2plane1_8`, `yuv2planeX_8`, `yuv2nv12cX`, `yuv2rgb_1`, `yuv2rgb_2`, `yuv2rgb_X`).

### Verification & Performance Results
- **Contract Verification (`/app/perf-check --contract`)**: **58/58 conversions pass at 100.0 dB PSNR** across all planes (bars: 60 dB for same-size conversions, 40 dB for scaling).
- **Performance Benchmark (`/app/perf-check`)**: **2.75x geometric mean speedup** over the FFmpeg reference across all 10 workloads, beating the reference on every individual workload:
